prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Berkelium (Bk) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: an outdoor bath, stream or fountain built in the style of her element's kingdom
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows; light glittering off the water, dappling her skin.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Small moment: her wet fringe clings to her forehead in loose strands.
Outfit: an oversized tee and shorts — in deep wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated sideways on a stool or bench, her torso turned toward the camera.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — berkelium: a soft silvery synthetic metal first made in late 1949 by striking americium with alpha particles, and named for the university town where she was born, just as terbium above her was named for a small village; the town itself was named for a philosopher who taught that to exist is to be perceived, and at first she existed only as the decay of a few atoms, until more than a decade later a speck large enough to see was gathered; in water she turns yellow and pale green, and in 2009 a few precious milligrams of her, gathered over months in a reactor, were flown across an ocean to another laboratory to become the target that made element 117 — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
